title: Live re-check — the committed 2026-11-19 official reads vs this session's second reads
method: Each live read is compared cell by cell with the committed 2026-11-19 pack read from the same official page. Every difference is published with both values and a source URL; nothing is overwritten in either direction. The live standings read must also satisfy the page's own arithmetic identities (NET = PF - PA, PCT, HOME + ROAD) before it is used, so a transcription slip cannot masquerade as a source change.
